messages:
Leah: quick thread on retirement hygiene for long-lived compatibility shims. we need a predictable pipeline so shims don't become permanent technical debt. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Omar: agreed. propose a retirement policy: owners must set an explicit expiry and a reason. if expiry passes, system auto-notifies customers and queues the shim for soft-disable.
Priya: what's soft-disable?
Leah: soft-disable = switch shim to "monitor-only": requests still get transformed but we increment `shim_monitor_hits` and surface diffs to owner console; after N days with zero hits we fully retire. this gives last-minute visibility.
Miguel: love monitor-only. add one more step: before any disable, we run a sampled diff smoke-check against canonical service. if diffs > threshold we block disable and page owner.
Omar: telemetry plan: emit events `shim_monitored`, `shim_retire_proposed`, `shim_retired` with fields {shim_id, dep_id, tenant, hits_last_30d}. SDKs also emit `shim_seen` for client-side exposures.
Priya: customer notifications: email + console banner + API header. header example we discussed before:
```
X-Rw-Compat-Status: id=SHIM-2026-123;status=monitor-only;expires=2026-10-05
```
Console shows per-tenant status and contact.
Leah: escalation playbook: if owner fails to respond within 7 days of expiry, create a TODO in the architecture queue and assign infra-owner to evaluate. after 14 days, auto-retire with notice to customers.
Miguel: require owners to provide a short migration snippet and a CI test vector when creating shim. without tests we refuse to create stable shims.
Omar: cost controls: mark shims routing to compatibility pool with `billing_tag`. when cost for a shim exceeds threshold (e.g., $X/day), owner receives immediate alert and we throttle shim traffic by % until owner pays or retires.
Priya: SLA concerns: if a shim increases p95 by >200ms for 10%+ traffic, auto-escalate and mark shim as "performance-risk". provide suggested mitigations: move mapping to upstream client, batch transform, or increase capacity.
Leah: UX: add a "Retirement forecast" view showing shims expiring in next 90 days, owners, and hit counts so PMs can plan migrations.
Miguel: automation idea: allow tenants to opt into a "compat-cleanup" beta: system will attempt to rewrite sampled client calls to new surface and report failures so customers can pre-validate before we remove shim.
Omar: security: any shim touching sensitive fields must require sec-approval and cannot be auto-retired; owner must re-certify quarterly.
Priya: testing: when retiring, run end-to-end smoke-check against top 10 tenants by hit volume. if any diffs, block and open remediation ticket.
Leah: action items: Omar to write retirement automation (ETA 4d), Miguel to add monitor-only smoke-check (ETA 3d), Priya to draft notification templates + console banner (ETA 2d). I'll update the RFC with this lifecycle and timelines.
retire-bot: system: retirement workflow SHIM-2026-123 scheduled for monitor-only at 6177777444 by Leah.
Leah: thanks everyone. we'll kick off with two high-risk shims next week and iterate. closing.
